name: M6.Spaces.dual_boundary_eval
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Spaces.dualBoundary N a b h = M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h))
guidance: Definitional equality of composed linear maps. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
